setup.enableHelp: Save the visible frame and the speech around it while you watch. The full recording is saved as well.
setup.sourceUrlHelp: Paste the video's address. The same video always opens the same notebook.
setup.sourceUrlInvalid: This is not a web link.
setup.sourceExists: This video already has the notebook "{{title}}". New notes are added to it.
setup.modeUntilStoppedHelp: The first press saves the frame and the 15 seconds before it. The next press ends the note.
setup.modeLast15Help: Every press saves the frame and the 15 seconds before it.
setup.notebookFailed: The notebook could not be opened. Try again.
setup.offerSlides: Offer to keep a slide when it changes
setup.offerSlidesHelp: When a new slide appears, you can still keep the previous one as a note for 20 seconds, with what was said before the change.
setup.enrichHelp: Adds a title, a tidy version of the text, key terms and the text on the slide. The image and the text of each note are sent to this installation's language model.
setup.researchWebHelp: When you press Question, the question itself (never the recording or its transcript) is sent to the Tavily search service. The answer lists the pages it used.
setup.enableHelpMic: Keep what was just said, mark it, or get a suggested answer to a question. Notes use the microphone and have no picture. The full recording is saved as well.

crop.title: Choose what to save
crop.intro: This is the tab you shared. Notes can keep the whole frame or only the video.
crop.areaHelp: Drag the frame, or use the arrow keys. Hold Shift to resize.
crop.previewFailed: No preview is available yet. Notes will use the full frame.
crop.fullscreenHint: A video in fullscreen needs no cropping.

dock.waiting_one: {{count}} note is waiting to be sent.
dock.waiting_other: {{count}} notes are waiting to be sent.
dock.screenshotOnlyHelp: To include speech, choose Change source, pick the tab again and turn on "Also share tab audio".
dock.videoLost: The shared tab is no longer available, so no notes can be taken. Choose Change source to share it again.
dock.pausedHint: Resume the recording to take notes.

notice.paused: The open note ended because the recording was paused.
notice.sharing_lost: The open note ended because the tab is no longer shared.
notice.max_length: The open note ended after 10 minutes.
notice.storage: The note could not be saved in this browser.
notice.source_changed: The open note ended because the source changed.
notice.offer_gone: That slide can no longer be kept.
notice.mic_lost: The open note ended because the microphone is no longer available.
notice.no_audio: Nothing has been heard yet, so there is nothing to keep.

dock.cancelAlsoNotes_one: The {{count}} note taken in it is discarded too.
dock.cancelAlsoNotes_other: The {{count}} notes taken in it are discarded too.
dock.micLost: The microphone is no longer available, so no notes can be taken.

float.videoLost: The tab is no longer shared.

changeSource.title: Change source
changeSource.intro: Share the tab with the next video. Notes from now on go to its notebook; the recording continues.
changeSource.notShared: No tab was shared. The current source is unchanged.

offer.announce: The slide changed. You can keep the previous slide as a note.

question.help: Somebody just asked a question: keep the last minute and suggest an answer

answer.title: Suggested answer
answer.listening: Listening back to the last minute…
answer.noQuestion: No question was heard in the last minute.
answer.noSpeech: Nothing was said in the last minute.
answer.unavailable: Answers need a language model, which this installation does not have.
answer.check: A suggestion. Check it before you rely on it.
answer.moreInNotebook: A suggestion. Sources and the full answer are in the notebook.
answer.question: Question

page.notebooksIntro: One notebook per video or meeting. Notes are added every time you record it again.
page.emptyHelp: Record a tab, turn on Take notes and press Take note while you watch or listen.
page.exportFailed: The notebook could not be exported.
page.exportDenied: A recording in this notebook is restricted. Ask an administrator for permission to export it.
page.deleteConfirm: Delete the notebook "{{title}}" with all its notes and images? This cannot be undone.
page.imageMissing: The image is no longer stored.

endReason.paused: Ended when the recording was paused.
endReason.sharing_lost: Ended when the tab was no longer shared.
endReason.interrupted: Ended when the page was closed.

page.sourceTimeHelp: Paste the player's "Copy video URL at current time" link.
page.sourceTimeOpen: Open this moment in the source
page.sourceTimeInvalid: The link does not point at this notebook's source.
page.loadFailed: The notebook could not be loaded.
page.thoughtsHelp: Saved when you leave the field. Exported apart from the transcript.
page.actions: More actions for the note at {{time}}
page.contextLabel: What was said around this note, {{start}}–{{end}}
page.contextEmpty: Nothing was said in this part.

contextReason.not_linked: Available when the recording has been uploaded and transcribed.
contextReason.not_transcribed: The recording has not been transcribed yet.

page.contextFailed: The surrounding text could not be loaded.
page.enrichFailed: The note could not be improved.
page.glossaryEmpty: No key terms yet. They are added when notes are improved with AI.
